questionEn: Which formulation more accurately separates “the rusting of iron is accelerated” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "temirning zanglashi tezlashadi" ni shunga o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
explanationEn: Acidic environments and salt water accelerate rusting.
explanationUz: Kislotali muhit va sho'r suv zanglashni tezlashtiradi.
